column1: # Text-to-speech voices for the benchmark corpus (docs/BENCHMARK.md). Only voices whose training data is CC0, public domain or CC BY 4.0 are listed;
# non-commercial, share-alike, AGPL, unclear ("see URL") and the Blizzard-licensed lessac voice were left out. Audio made with these voices is generated into
# an ignored folder and never committed. Source of every voice: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices (licence of the repository: MIT; the
# licence column is the licence of each voice's training data, from its MODEL_CARD, read on 2026-10-27). Columns, separated by a tab:
# id, language, path, quality, sample rate, speaker ids used (- for a single-speaker voice), licence, dataset, onnx bytes, onnx sha256 (the SHA-256 Hugging Face publishes for the file).
